title: Evidence
description: The result of one run of a check or eval, stored at <venture>/evidence/results/<id>.json (EE-017). It names what was checked, at which version, each assertion's outcome and the output that shows it. Results are append-only: a new run writes a new file. Handoffs point at results to prove their done-criteria.

version.description: Commit, tag or version the run checked

suite.description: Path to the eval suite, when the run came from one

runner.description: Who or what ran it: a CI job, a session id, a role

criterion.description: A handoff done-criterion id, or an eval assertion name

kind.description: judged: scored by a model against a rubric, which counts as evidence only for review and evals, never conformance

output.description: The output, trimmed to what shows the outcome

artifact.description: Path or link to a screenshot, log or report

by.description: For review results: the role that judged it, which must be the criterion's reviewer and not the handoff's holder

passed.description: True only when every result passed
